name: zzT2_dusk_hole

tests.name: each rung agrees with itself -- two reads of the same hour

detail.note: red here voids everything below, because every gate under it compares rungs to each other

tests.name: the evening dips BELOW full night and climbs back out, rather than simply falling

detail.note: a monotone fall into night is correct behaviour and needs no fix. A dip means the world goes darker than night and then comes back, which is a defect at one hour

tests.name: the bottom sits in the gap between the two curves, where the explanation puts it

detail.note: Daylight reaches zero at -9 deg and Nightfall does not start until -2. A minimum anywhere else means the crossover gap is not the cause

tests.name: the ground stays readable through the whole crossover

detail.note: the founder's complaint is that the ground is unreadable and paths disappear. This measures that sentence rather than the whole frame
